_real_world.class: Lockheed Martin AN/APY-9 UHF AESA surveillance radar
_real_world.variant_scope: AN/APY-9 as fitted to E-2D Advanced Hawkeye (mechanical 360-degree rotation with a 90-degree electronic sector scan)
public_equipment: AN/APY-9 UHF AESA, mechanical + electronic scan, 360 degree coverage with 90-degree electronic sector; ~300-350 nmi search range (CSG order-of-battle page, Tier C-est)

_provenance.modeling_note: AEW&C primary sensor for CVW-8's E-2D (modeled as a C2Node per the e3_sentry.json precedent). max_range is taken from the CSG order-of-battle page's C-est band (~300-350 nmi; USNI News says 'at least 300 nmi', Wikipedia says ~350 nmi against an unspecified target RCS), using the midpoint 325 nmi = 601 km. The 360-degree mechanical + 90-degree electronic sector scan and the AESA/UHF radar type are Tier A/B (Lockheed Martin, DOT&E FY25). scan_period/detection_prob/noise/track_memory fields have no public figures and are proxy values patterned on the repo e3_sentry.json inline AWACS sensor block (aircraft/units/e3_sentry.json), a comparable long-range rotating-AEW radar, scaled up modestly for detection_prob and track_memory to reflect the newer AESA generation and NIFC-CA role.

sensor.max_range.note: midpoint of the OOB page's 300-350 nmi C-est band; 325 nmi x 1852 = 601,900 m, rounded 601000 m

sensor.fov_deg.note: 360-degree mechanical rotation confirmed by Lockheed Martin and DOT&E FY25 per the OOB page

sensor.scan_period.note: engineering_estimate faster than repo e3_sentry's 10.0 s (AESA electronic sector scan component vs pure mechanical AWACS rotation), not a quantified public figure

sensor.detection_prob.note: proxy close to repo e3_sentry's 0.99, marginally reduced pending calibration; no public figure

sensor.range_noise_std.note: proxy close to repo e3_sentry's 100.0, scaled slightly down for the newer AESA

sensor.range_power.note: proxy copied from repo e3_sentry (radar-equation exponent, not platform-specific)

sensor.aspect_influence.note: proxy copied from repo e3_sentry's 0.0 (omnidirectional AEW radar, aspect-independent)
